tooltip.essentialcraft5.rewind_module.en: A fatal blow sends you back to where you stood a few seconds ago, with the health you had then
tooltip.essentialcraft5.rewind_module.zh: 受到致命一击时退回几秒前站过的地方，生命回到当时的数

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_filter_mo.en: Harmful effects can't be put on you; each one blocked is added as matrix damage instead
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_filter_mo.zh: 有害的状态效果加不到身上，每拦下一个改记矩阵损伤

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_shunt_mod.en: Part of each magic damage is taken as matrix damage instead of health
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_shunt_mod.zh: 魔法伤害分出一部分不扣血，改记矩阵损伤
